description: Average household electricity price per kWh in one European country, every half-year, for a typical home using 2,500-5,000 kWh a year, with all taxes included by default. Answers "how much does electricity cost in Germany per kWh" or "where is power cheapest in Europe". Source: Eurostat dataset nrg_pc_204. Averages across tariffs, so a given contract can be higher or lower; published with a lag of a few months. (cost: 1 credit)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent half-years, 1-100, default 4

tax.description: string, optional: 'I_TAX' all taxes and levies included (default), 'X_TAX' excluding taxes, 'X_VAT' excluding VAT

name: eu_household_electricity_price
